results.headline: Exxon Q3 Earnings Beat on Pioneer Synergies; OPEC Uncertainty Clouds Q4 Outlook
results.body: Exxon Mobil reported Q3 earnings of $1.92 per share, beating estimates of $1.88. The Pioneer Natural Resources acquisition added $500 million in synergies ahead of schedule. However, executives cautioned that the OPEC+ production policy uncertainty and global demand softness could weigh on Q4 results. The company maintained its $35 billion share buyback program.

[Source: news-xom-003] Exxon Q3 Earnings Beat on Pioneer Synergies; OPEC Uncertainty Clouds Q4 Outlook
Exxon Mobil reported Q3 earnings of $1.92 per share, beating estimates of $1.88. The Pioneer Natural Resources acquisition added $500 million in synergies ahead of schedule. However, executives cautioned that the OPEC+ production policy uncertainty and global demand softness could weigh on Q4 results. The company maintained its $35 billion share buyback program.

Analyst sentiment on XOM is currently NEUTRAL.
[Source: rating-xom-001] Of 2 recent ratings: 0 bullish, 1 neutral, 1 bearish. Average price target: $126.
[Source: rating-xom-001] Piper Sandler (Ryan Todd) Maintains at Overweight, PT $135.0 (from $130.0). Pioneer integration tracking ahead of plan; structural cost advantages intact.
[Source: rating-xom-002] JPMorgan (Phil Gresh) Maintains at Neutral, PT $118.0 (from $118.0). Oil price uncertainty from OPEC policy caps upside; disciplined capex a positive.

[Source: guidance-xom-001] XOM issued Capital Expenditure guidance of $28.0B for FY2024 (issued 2024-02-01). Prior analyst estimate was $27.5B.
  Notes: Exxon guided FY2024 capex to $28B, consistent with prior year plan, in line with analyst estimates.

[Source: earnings-xom-001] XOM Q3 2024 earnings (reported 2024-11-01): Revenue $90.0B vs. estimate $90.2B — MISS (-0.2%). EPS $1.92 vs. estimate $1.88 — BEAT (+2.1%). Revenue grew -5.0% year-over-year.
  Notes: EPS beat driven by Pioneer synergies of $500M ahead of schedule. Revenue slightly missed due to lower oil prices. $35B buyback program maintained.
